text:
marta (sales): Quick heads-up, ACME POC demo blocked. /v1/generate returns 403 "invalid_project_claim" during the token validation step. They said it worked yesterday.

acme-admin (customer): here's the exact curl we used (key masked):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-x","prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response: 403 {"error":"invalid_project_claim","detail":"token not bound to project proj-acme-123"}

samir (solutions): Do they have a user-exported key or a service account? User keys are often org-scoped/default-project and won't be bound to the POC project. For demos we usually create a service-account key bound to the POC project.

oliver (eng-oncall): Quick debug step - ask them to hit the auth debug endpoint to inspect token claims (mask token).
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/debug
```
Expected minimal output: {"sub":"user:rebecca","projects": ["proj-default"], "scopes": ["generate:chat"]}
If proj-acme-123 isn't present that's why it's rejected.

acme-admin (customer): pasted masked debug output: {"sub":"user:rebecca","projects": ["proj-default"], "scopes": ["generate:chat", "embeddings:read"]} -- so not bound to proj-acme-123.

marta (sales): Got it. What's the fastest path to fix for the live demo?

samir (solutions): Two options: 1) Rebind the existing key to proj-acme-123 via the management API (requires admin key perms). 2) Create a service-account key scoped to proj-acme-123 (recommended for POC longevity).

Binding example: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/<key-id>/bind Body: {"project":"proj-acme-123"} (needs admin/keys:write)

oliver (eng-oncall): Short-term workaround that often unblocks demos: include the X-Project header. If org policy allows header override it routes the request to the target project while the binding is fixed.
Example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "X-Project: proj-acme-123" -d '{"model":"gpt-x","prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

acme-admin (customer): tried the X-Project header and now the call returns 200 and the model responded. Demo unblocked for now.

marta (sales): Great, please keep that in place until we sort the permanent fix. Next actions: Samir to DM service-account script, Tara to create/bind SA to proj-acme-123, Security to confirm questionnaire upload. I'll open a support ticket and add ACME contacts.

tara (eng-platform): I'll provision a service account and bind it to proj-acme-123. Which scopes should we give it?

oliver (eng-oncall): For generation give generate:* scopes you need (generate:chat, generate:stream). If you want embeddings also add embeddings:write/read. Also prefer long-lived SA keys for POC to avoid short expiry user tokens.

security-bot: Sent security questionnaire link to ACME: https://redwood.ai/security/questionnaire Please upload completed PDF.

samir (solutions): Pricing note for sales: trial/user-scoped keys have soft token caps and burst throttles (typical trial caps ~10k tokens/day). If ACME needs sustained throughput recommend a short Dedicated eval or a promo for reserved burst. I'll send a short pricing note with numbers to marta.

acme-admin (customer): thanks everyone, appreciate the quick assist :thumbsup:

marta (sales): Closing loop: (1) tara will create SA + bind to proj-acme-123, (2) samir will DM the SA creation script & pricing note, (3) security-bot will track the questionnaire. Reopen if something else pops up. :raised_hands:
